summary: Ferrovial N.V. filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing an investor presentation dated October 5, 2026, covering its I-24 Choice Lanes project, with the exhibit also posted to the company's investor relations site. No transaction, stake, price per share, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics are disclosed; the disclosure is project-level and forward-looking. The filing maps to a US Form 8-K furnishing investor materials rather than a special-situation event. Watch for future 6-K updates on project construction timing, service commencement, and any related concession financing.
